instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do not use generic rounding (rounded-lg). Architecture demands sharp corners (rounded-none) to reflect precision.
2. For hero section overlay, do not use flat opacity. Use a gradient from black/60 at the bottom to black/10 at the top, or warm-tinted dark overlay.
3. Dashboard uses 'Control Room Grid'. Dense, white background, functional. Marketing pages use 'Tetris Grid' with extreme asymmetry and generous negative space.
4. Install @phosphor-icons/react and use it for all iconography to maintain a high-end editorial feel.
5. Do NOT center align text in marketing sections unless explicitly acting as a dramatic quote. Left-align for architectural precision.
6. Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Ensure tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em).
8. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fades and staggered reveals in the Portfolio gallery.
9. The Contact form should look like a blueprint or high-end editorial form: no borders except bottom borders on inputs. No native browser input styles.
10. Client dashboard must feature a clear visual hierarchy with pure white cards on the #F5F3EF background for maximum contrast and legibility.
